entry.title: Avara Real Estate
entry.summary: Property discovery, transactions and host operations in Sri Lanka. This diagram summarizes the repository’s property, booking and payment boundaries. PayHere and S3 require deployment-specific configuration.

entry.title: Blu.lk
entry.summary: Home-service discovery, booking and fulfillment in Sri Lanka. This diagram covers the core service platform. Payment-provider availability depends on integration configuration; no specific online payment launch is claimed here.

entry.title: FreshPick / FreshOnTime
entry.summary: Food commerce, producer onboarding and scheduled recurring deliveries in Colombo. Customer checkout and subscription baskets currently use cash on delivery. Automatic recurring card charging is not implemented. Subscription baskets and recurring grocery orders are distinct workflows.

entry.title: TimelyHelp.lk
entry.summary: Product and frontend work for practitioner discovery and consultation journeys. Savi’s portfolio contribution is product and frontend work. This page summarizes that frontend boundary and does not claim ownership of the full clinical backend.

entry.title: DevRelOS
entry.summary: A self-hosted beta for discovery, engagement and outcome measurement. This project is a self-hosted beta. External providers require credentials and policy configuration; consequential outreach follows approval workflows.

entry.title: Property Management OS
entry.summary: Multi-tenant rental operations and controlled agent-assisted work. MCP calls the same authenticated HTTP API as other clients and has no direct database connection. Advanced financial writes and other domains remain subject to the project’s implemented tool scope.

entry.title: RapidReach
entry.summary: Developer publishing and tool discovery with a small CMS. RapidReach uses one Next.js application with MongoDB and Blob storage; there is no separate backend service. Publishing and media require a configured deployment.

entry.title: Advance HRIS
entry.summary: Hybrid web and local-first desktop HR operations. Local-first refers to the desktop console. The cloud database remains authoritative. Payroll-ready attendance boundaries do not mean a complete payroll-processing product is included.

entry.title: NexusPOS
entry.summary: Checkout and store operations with an optional Electron desktop shell. Electron is an optional desktop shell. The portfolio does not claim a complete offline checkout engine or a tenant-isolated hosted retail service.

entry.title: Academix
entry.summary: Student, academic and fee operations in a role-aware workspace. The account and plan surfaces support a SaaS direction. Automated billing and broader tenant-isolation work should be checked against the current project roadmap rather than assumed complete.

entry.title: Acme Accounting
entry.summary: Single-company financial operations backed by a double-entry ledger. The current application is designed for one company and one administrator identity per database. It is not a tenant-isolated accounting SaaS backend.

entry.title: EventOS
entry.summary: Quick provider matching and full event procurement. Payments are submitted and reconciled manually in the current MVP. This is a Next.js and PostgreSQL application; a Supabase service is not required for the documented runtime.

entry.title: Plate Restaurant OS
entry.summary: Restaurant point of sale and coordinated order operations. The product is under development. POS, kitchen and online ordering share a Next.js application and MongoDB data layer; external integrations require deployment-specific configuration.

entry.title: Pain Intelligence Lab
entry.summary: Cross-source pain research and evidence-backed opportunity validation. The application does not call model-provider APIs directly; semantic reasoning runs in the connected MCP host. A research job may correctly produce no validated opportunity.

entry.title: Ad Performance Analysis Agent
entry.summary: An advertising analytics and reporting prototype. Google Ads and Supermetrics connection endpoints are currently mocks. Scheduled demonstration runs use generated sample CSVs and in-memory configuration, rather than a durable live account-ingestion pipeline.

entry.title: MediCare
entry.summary: Patient administration, appointments, clinical records and billing. The main clinic API and embeddable scheduling API use separate service boundaries. Server-enforced roles separate clinical, billing and administrative access.
